content.title: Cloudflare outage hits OpenAI, the mega paint merger worth $17B
content.description:
Julie Hyman takes a closer look at the stories behind some of the trending tickers on Yahoo Finance's platform.

A Cloudflare (NET) outage hits several sites, including OpenAI's (OPAI.PVT) ChatGPT and Elon Musk's X.

Redburn analysts downgrade Amazon (AMZN) and Microsoft (MSFT), raising AI concerns.

Akzo Nobel (AKUP.SG) and Axalta Coating Systems (AXTA) are merging to form a $17 billion paint giant.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Morning Brief.
